page: Microsoft Azure D64s_v4 is a general-purpose virtual machine designed for balanced compute and memory-intensive enterprise tasks. Powered by the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor on the x86_64 architecture, the instance provides 64 dedicated vCPUs across 32 physical cores running at a base frequency of 2.6 GHz. The underlying hardware is an Intel Xeon Platinum 8272CL processor, featuring 32 KB L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and a shared 35 MB L3 cache. Instruction set extensions include AVX-512 with VNNI support, enabling accelerated vector operations and quantized deep learning routines.

System memory totals 256.0 GB, maintaining a standard 1:4 core-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Benchmark evaluations show strong memory throughput, achieving uncached large-block read speeds of 212.55 GB/sec and write speeds of 95.66 GB/sec, placing memory bandwidth in the top tier of comparable instances. General compute metrics, including PassMark CPU and Geekbench scores, place the system in the middle performance tier, while PassMark extended instructions tests demonstrate strong performance due to AVX-512 capabilities.

The D64s_v4 does not include bundled local storage or integrated hardware accelerators, requiring external premium managed disks for persistent storage needs. Network configurations do not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses by default. While lacking ephemeral scratch disks, the configuration delivers consistent CPU pinning without credit throttling, offering dependable cost efficiency across scale-up enterprise workloads.

Given its high core count, substantial memory capacity, and robust memory bandwidth, Microsoft Azure D64s_v4 is suited for large relational databases, in-memory caches such as Redis, enterprise web applications, CI/CD compilation pipelines, and container orchestration nodes.
description: Microsoft Azure D64s_v4 is a general-purpose virtual machine delivering 64 dedicated vCPUs and 256.0 GB of system memory on an x86_64 architecture. Equipped with an Intel Xeon Platinum 8272CL processor operating at 2.6 GHz, the instance spans 32 physical cores with hyperthreading and includes AVX-512 VNNI vector instruction support. Memory throughput demonstrates strong performance, sustaining 212.55 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 95.66 GB/sec for uncached writes. The instance does not include integrated local disk storage or GPU acceleration, instead relying on network-attached premium storage volumes. With a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio, the D64s_v4 offers balanced compute density and predictable performance, making it appropriate for large-scale enterprise applications, high-throughput web serving, build automation, and medium-scale database workloads requiring substantial concurrent processing capability.
